verdict.rationale: The pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the Unleash product itself. The MCP server serves external LLM coding assistants, which is a different capability. Impact metrics and the stale-flag dashboard are threshold-based or reporting features, not AI-generated insights, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
